name: Hide (Action)
desc: When you take the Hide action you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check in an attempt to hide, following the rules for hiding. If you succeed, you gain benefits against creatures that can't see you: you have advantage on attack rolls against them, and they attack you with disadvantage. You can't hide from a creature that can see you clearly, and you give away your position if you make noise.
